description: Happy path: ingest a JSONL bundle with 3 events (1 user_message, 1 decision_confirmed, 1 tool_call), then re-ingest the same bundle. The seed step produces the session + 3 events; the re_ingest_session operation must be a no-op (replay-safe per ADR-0011) and return the original session_id. A `bundle_hash_drift` would surface as an error and fail the fixture. Exercises dimension A (ingestion) and dimension E (interruption / retry).
